list.comment:
feat(ui): add login view and password masking to text input
- Add LoginView for authenticating users against servers. - Add new_password constructor and password masking to TextInput. - Update AppView and ServerListView to support login flow. - Add credentials dependency for secure token storage. - Include LoginView in app rendering logic. - Minor refactoring and UI improvements.

task.summary:
feat(app): add auto-login and improve server/user management (master)
- Implement auto-login with last connected user - Add last_connected_user_id to Config, with set/clear methods - Update active_server handling and saving in state - Refactor AppLayout/AppSidebar to allow logout logic - Sidebar now provides logout button to clear user and return to selection - Clean up unused .idea files and update vcs.xml - Add .idea/workspace.xml for IDE configuration
Update `.idea` config: include additional source folders and enable default features for crates
Update `.idea` config: refine change list and task updates
Switch `.idea` build profile to test, add integration test configuration

feat(settings,credentials): implement config and credential storage
- Implemented settings management in `crates/settings`, including: - Serializable `Config`, `ServerConfig`, `UserConfig` structs - Load/save, add/remove servers/users, versioning - File watching for config hot-reload with `notify` - Extensive tests, integration test for workflow - Implemented secure token storage in `crates/credentials` using `keyring` - `store_token`, `get_token`, `delete_token` functions - Error handling, tests with `uuid` support - Updated `Cargo.toml` files to add dependencies: - `keyring`, `notify`, `uuid`, `tempfile` - Updated workspace configuration for new dependencies - Added dev-dependencies and integration test in settings crate
